title: SemAxis: A Lightweight Framework to Characterize Domain-Specific Word Semantics Beyond Sentiment
reasoning: The paper includes a qualitative evaluation and analysis of word semantics within religious communities (comparing /r/atheism and /r/Christianity) using a 'Holy' vs. 'Unholy' semantic axis. It also characterizes words based on moral and ethical dimensions such as 'honorable' vs. 'despicable' and 'respectful' vs. 'disrespectful'.
